notes.title: Legrand Legacy v2.0 - New and Improved!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/8d06d279ebfe11c111f355031218d215ebeb2cbf.jpg[/img]
Hello, Legrandians!

Thanks to the feedback and recommendations from you guys,  we’ve finished our complete rewrite of the games script, fixed a few bugs, and straightened out other minor issues, and today… the motherlode finally hits our Steam store. 

That’s right, the all shiny, all new and improved Legrand Legacy v2.0 drops today! If you’re wondering what this means for your gaming experience, read on.

[h1]MAJOR CHANGES TO COMBAT AND BATTLE SYSTEM
[/h1]We have replaced the old battle system completely and re-coded from the ground up. This massive update includes:

	a. Significant improvements to combat camera and new impact effects
You will see that camera movements during battles have been upgraded with dynamic angles and we’ve added fancy impact effects to make your heroes feel all the more badass.
			
	b. Difficulty selection
We included a difficulty selection to cater to your needs. Want to enjoy the story but think the combat is too hard? Play on “easy” and breeze through your adventure. Up for a hardcore challenge and want to put your gaming skills to the ultimate test? Play on “hard!”
		
	c. ACT mode option (easy or off/automatic)
After a lot of feedback, we discovered that some of you don't like to have to press the ACT with every turn, so we’ve added the option to make the ACT dial easier OR to turn off the ACT completely and make it automatic instead.

	d. Updated enemy AI
While updating the code of our combat system, we discovered that some of the enemy AI did not work as intended. We have fixed those problems. 

	e. Rebalanced most of the combat
After fixing the enemy AI, implementing a new difficulty selection, and the automatic ACT, we have also updated the combat balance to fit the new AI. Enemies are smart but not too smart!

	f.  Move command no longer takes a character's whole turn
You will now be able to perform an action after moving and not waste a character's whole turn just to reposition.

	g. Improved Arcana cinematics
We have improved the cinematic sequence during Arcanas so they’re more dramatic. We’re talking about some SERIOUS eye candy here, people.
	
[h1]GRAPHICAL IMPROVEMENTS
[/h1]We have modified the old shaders so the new shaders now enable normal maps, which means more refined and prettier details on the 3D model textures. 

[h1]COMPLETION OF SCRIPT REWRITE AND EXTENDED ENDING
[/h1]Following our announcement about our attempt to rewrite the script, this update completes the revised writing. You can now enjoy Legrand Legacy’s newly rewritten and polished script in its entirety. Plus, we have also extended the ending with additional cutscenes to clarify the conclusion of our heroes’ story.

[h1]SKIPPABLE CUTSCENES
[/h1]During cutscenes, you can now press the cancel button and then the confirm button to skip the current cutscene entirely.

[h1]TACTICAL WAR QUICK RETRY
[/h1]Now when you lose a tactical war, there will be a prompt so you can try it again.

[h1]OTHER MINOR BUGS
[/h1]As always, we have also fixed other minor bugs.

******* SPOILER ALERT *******
There is a break and save point in Crimson Canyon (chapter 8), so you can pause and take a breath between the tactical wars and boss battle marathon.

Finally, we thank you for being supportive and vocal of the improvements you wanted to see! We may be a small studio, but we hope that we have been able to respond to your feedback quickly enough. We can’t wait to hear what you think about this new update, so don’t forget to LEAVE YOUR COMMENTS after you’ve tried the new and improved Legrand Legacy v2.0.

Oh and positive reviews would be lovely too!

notes.title: A Voice for Legrand
notes.content:
Hi everyone! [b]Legrand Legacy’s launch on JANUARY 24th[/b] is fast approaching and we are [i]cautiously[/i] happy to report that everything is going well at the studio. Development, localization, and other launching prep work are well under way.

Today, we have a special news to share with you.

From the beginning, we wanted Legrand Legacy to be an homage to classic JRPGs, so the game has to be enjoyable, aesthetically delightful, and also sounds beautiful. But more than that, we wanted the game to have [b]a voice that truly captures the spirit of Legrand[/b]. We searched high and low for that perfect voice, until one day, during one of our trips, almost by chance, we finally found her...

Beautiful inside out, with an ethereal voice to boot, we proudly introduce... [b]EMI EVANS[/b]! Here's a sneak preview of what we have in store for you.

https://youtu.be/DkpnyCdHaK0
Sigh, don't you think she sounds beautiful even when she's just speaking?

We immediately fell head over heels with Emi Evans the moment we listened to Nier Automata’s soundtrack. Her chaos language is sublime, enigmatic, and gorgeous beyond words. To be honest, it's an honor for us that she will be singing a song for Legrand Legacy. 

If you have never listened to Nier Automata soundtrack, please watch the following video. 

https://youtu.be/Wzh_kyMp55U
Simply... Breathtaking...

We were lucky enough to sit down with Emi Evans and how she ended up singing for Nier Automata was truly an inspiring story for aspiring artists everywhere, including us. She's living proof that NOTHING can replace years of commitment, a ton of moxie, and a dash of luck.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/52b301597648560043aaa4481d2d0936e18390f0.jpg[/img]
AJ, Henry, and Aki may look super chill, but deep inside they all felt like Auliya :D
 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/012d1fe3eb46653cf62ed46dc5738c58b5eddb27.jpg[/img]
Always poised, always graceful, we're so in love with Emi Evans.

You have to wait a few more days to listen to the full song, Suteki No Mono, but I know you will love it. I hope that you are excited to hear what we have in store for you! 

See you in the next update and I hope you have JANUARY 24th marked on your calendar.

- Revinia & the SEMISOFT team -

notes.title: Introducing Our Publishers, Release Date Update, and Discord!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! The past few weeks have been pretty busy and intense (in a good way) for everyone at the studio, but we haven’t forgotten about you. In fact, we have some very exciting updates regarding Legrand Legacy’s release!  

[h1]Introducing… Our Publishers![/h1] 

We’re thrilled to announce that we are partnering with two esteemed publishers for the release of Legrand Legacy. [b]ANOTHER INDIE[/b] will be working with us for our worldwide launch, while [b]MAYFLOWER ENTERTAINMENT[/b] will be taking care of our South Korean players. You might have heard of [url=http://anotherindie.com/games/]Another Indie[/url] from other premium games, like Lost Castle and Sinner, so we're looking forward to working with them on Legrand Legacy.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/e1df5fdf832b3434e3259279fc6e334f566a4bfd.jpg[/img][i]Watch out world![/i]

[b]What does this mean for you?[/b]

Well, this means that Legrand Legacy will be coming to you in [b]English, Russian, Mandarin Chinese, Korean,[/b] and a few [b]more languages[/b] planned in the near future. This also means that you will be seeing more of us in [b]upcoming events[/b], like GDC or PAX East, so we can say hi to you face to face. Lastly, we hope you’re looking forward to a ton of [b]swags, giveaways, and freebies[/b] for Legrand Legacy’s launch because we’ll have LOTS of them!  

[h1]Release Date & Discord[/h1]  
Our current goal is to release Legrand Legacy for Windows [b]some time in January 2018[/b]. We’re still ironing out the details so we don’t have an exact date yet. 

In the meantime, we've set up an [b]official Discord[/b] (discord.gg/ai) and we cordially invite you to hang out with Henry, AJ, and me, along with fellow Legrand Legacy players for some pre-launch fun. If you have any questions and suggestions about Legrand Legacy or life as a gamedev in general, please don't hesitate to drop by!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/dcaf623f9468594dbaea765c5cd1d27dc745162f.jpg[/img][i]Come hang out with us :)[/i]
 
[h1]Thanks for Reading[/h1]

These partnerships are a HUGE deal for us because it means that Legrand Legacy will be able to reach MORE players worldwide, so we hope that you’re as excited to read today’s update as we are. We do have a few more surprises in store, so stay tuned for the next update! 

-Revinia & the SEMISOFT team-

notes.title: Pictures from Tokyo Game Show 2017
notes.content:
[h1]Hi Everyone![/h1]

In the last update we announced that we needed additional time to complete the development of Legrand Legacy. To be honest, we were very anxious because we really wanted to deliver our promises on time. However, we also realized that it was much more important to have a polished and thoroughly enjoyable, bug-free game. So for your understanding and kind comments, backers, we THANK YOU!

[h1]Tokyo Game Show 2017[/h1]

In today's update, we'd like to share some photos from Tokyo Game Show which took place on September 21st - 24th. This was actually not Henry and AJ's first TGS. Legrand Legacy was also present in 2015 and 2016, but under very different circumstances. In 2015, we were new and barely had anything to show. In 2016, we brought an acceptable demo, but our booth was not well-designed and a little blah.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/fd16c9200f3777f538273fb32d5c85a044f96b7f.jpg[/img][i]The Legrand Legacy crew circa 2016, we looked so much younger then. This game dev business has aged us! :D[/i]

This year, however, we had an extensive demo that covered most of the features in the game, including mini games, exploration, craftsmen recruiting, as well as more polished visual effects. We also got the full support of the Indonesian government who provided us with a super shiny booth to showcase Legrand Legacy alongside other up and coming local devs, like Celestian Tales (who recently just completed their Kickstarter campaign) and Forged of Blood. Simply put, it was an opportunity any indie dev would be jealous of and definitely a proud moment for everyone at SEMISOFT *tears of joy*.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/d3d93c8153ca36f0bdc7f91334f8343f07a5422e.jpg[/img][i]This is our third Tokyo Game Show, but the first one where we have a proper BIG banner.[/i]
 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/0061dc7591e083559cdfb356fb7bba03479bf171.jpg[/img][i]Thanks for playing guys![/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/1c27614ff06ac60a802c948e2f764f337bcf1a67.jpg[/img][i]You're never too young to start gaming![/i]

Then we met the legendary Takashi Tokita, who was the genius behind Final Fantasy IV - the first game that made Henry fell in love with JRPG #nerdsohard.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/ce0d6773ff784718ebf63f2157ad78e17b26a61e.jpg[/img][i]Omg omg omg![/i]

On top of that, we had fancy gaming laptops and other gears, courtesy of our friends at Gigabyte and Razer. These were high performance laptops that were sleek, lightweight, and most importantly, easy to travel with. We were very proud to show Legrand Legacy with these laptops.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/26efb4b3e01ddd06b7acfc04fab1835b4a49a4d6.jpg[/img][i]Fancy gaming laptops courtesy of Gigabyte and Razer.[/i]

The best part about TGS? The cosplay, no doubt. We'll share some pictures here and let you be the judge...

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/cdacc66ef5b87ac65f14cfea4de33312bff48bb5.jpg[/img][i]Weapons of mass distraction...[/i]
 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/0e76e461c02de04afae9012119c15267105d56a1.jpg[/img][i]Make way for Gundam Unicorn NT-D Mode![/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/ef7170ba1c5478c5a04d2b297dd5f49b3401bf93.jpg[/img][i]You know you're in Japan when...[/i]
 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/53a1356150f1c32fbbd47260b7684aff90ecdabb.jpg[/img][i]Seriously impressed by this costume. What is that even made of?[/i]

[h1]Thanks for Reading[/h1]

Hope you enjoyed reading this week's update. We have a very nice surprise for you so watch out for the next update!

-Revinia & the SEMISOFT Team-

notes.title: Early Access Keys // Volunteers for PAX West // We're Going to Gamescom Germany // Last Chance for Backers Survey!
notes.content:
[h1]TL;DR[/h1]

Hi everyone, this week's update is filled with a bunch of wonderful news, but if you have less than 1 minute, here's the TL;DR

✔️ Check your email for [b]early access keys[/b]
✔️ We're looking for a [b]volunteer[/b] to help us in [b]PAX West[/b] Seattle, USA (Sep 1-4)
✔️ We're also going to [b]Gamescom[/b] in Cologne, Germany (Aug 22-26)
✔️ [b]Backers' survey[/b] will be closed on August 19th (12:00am PDT)

Now, if you have slightly more time, please continue reading the rest of this update!

[h1]Check Your Email for Early Access Keys[/h1]

If you have backed us at the [b]CARTOGRAPHER (£30)[/b] tier and above through Kickstarter or PayPal, you should have received an email with a detailed step-by-step on how to play Legrand Legacy’s early access demo. 

For backers in the EXPLORER (£40) tier and above, if you have downloaded our Beta demo, then your game will be automatically updated to the latest version and you don't have to do anything else.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/017/889/622/39b53fe0a9700134caa9e38e43a81939_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1502506438&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=5ac30299d58e810b1f67e9bbc268b3dd[/img][i]Check your emails! Or else...[/i]

If you encounter any bugs or issues while playing the early access demo, or if you have any feedback, please log them in our Steam discussion thread and we'll try to address them one by one:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/556740/discussions/0/1471967615872242417/

[h1]Volunteers for PAX West Seattle, USA (September 1-4)[/h1]

Legrand Legacy is coming to PAX West courtesy of [b]Indie Megabooth[/b] and [b]Intel[/b]! The truth is, this was the second time we applied for Indie Megabooth at PAX. Although we failed the first time, we decided to try again and this time, not only did we get selected, but Intel decided to sponsor us! *Excitement level over 9000*!!!

Henry and AJ will be there, but we're also looking for a volunteer to help us out at our booth because the PAX crowd is insane! If you fancy a free pass to PAX West and want to share the joy of Legrand Legacy with the world, please email us at [u][b]hello@semisoft.co[/b][/u]. Of course, we have prepared a special something for our volunteers :)

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/017/912/037/86b319e33510825f1121c827853086bf_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1502709641&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=f63169769910e7db38260836210f5d8d[/img][i]Will you be our volunteer in PAX West?[/i]

These are the games that will be showcasing in this year's PAX West: http://indiemegabooth.com/event/pax-west-2017-3/

And this is our very own page: http://indiemegabooth.com/project/legrand-legacy/

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/7b18fc56c52123b318d53e4592f5ceed2d7388ae.jpg[/img][i]Say hi to Finn and friends in PAX West![/i]

[h1]Gamescom Germany, Here We Come![/h1]

Another event that we will be attending is [b]Gamescom in Cologne, Germany (September 22-26)[/b] with special thanks to the kind folks at Indie Arena Booth. If you're going to be at Gamescom, please come say hi to Henry and AJ in Indie Arena Booth (Hall 10.1 A-020).

These are the games that will be showcasing with Indie Arena Booth in Gamescom: http://indiegames.com/2017/07/indie_arena_booth_2017_announc.html

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/017/911/335/4d964a41dbddca6e39ac6f27039334ec_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1502703176&auto=format&q=92&s=b0d4b8ccd107eaa1cc14049d01b444b0[/img][i]New pop-artsy shirts for Gamescom & PAX West! Want one?[/i]
 
[h1]Last Call for Backers Survey (August 19th)[/h1]

Whether you're a Kickstarter or PayPal backer, you should have received your backers survey in your emails a few weeks ago. Please complete the survey as soon as possible. We need your most updated email and address to ensure that your digital and physical rewards will be delivered correctly. Most importantly, we are now finalizing most of the scenes in the game, including game credits, Fallen Gladiators of Legrand, and Monument of the Ancient. So please fill out the survey and make sure you tell us the names you want to put in the game according to the tier that you chose.

[b]LAST DAY TO SUBMIT YOUR SURVEY IS AUGUST 19th (12:00am PDT).[/b]

If you submit or make any changes to the survey after August 19th, we cannot guarantee that the name you requested will be correctly featured in the final game.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/017/912/089/12b5e7080694214e844c0e21b88de09e_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1502709940&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=42dd6ad4a8a85c89b48e3b39c56b00f4[/img] [i]Fill out those surveys! Or else...[/i]

[h1]Thanks for Reading[/h1]

Phew, that was ONE LONG UPDATE. In the mean time, hope you'll have a good time exploring Legrand in the early access demo! Thanks, and we'll report back next week with more fun stuff!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/017/912/859/923732f48370eee5d94e37e248fd2a53_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1502716628&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=5c3527249f68f5b90bb763681e218bc6[/img][i]See you next week![/i]

-Revinia & The SEMISOFT Team-

notes.title: Snapshots from E3 2017 & E3 Week MIX 2017
notes.content:
[h1]Hello from Los Angeles[/h1]  
The moment Henry picked up his E3 badge was a special one. This is SEMISOFT’s first E3 and to see it printed on the badge is a very exciting yet surreal moment. We are a small-ish company now but one day, we hope to make games as big as some of these guys in E3. 

On top of that, the lady at the counter said, "be careful with this badge, it's worth $1000" - holy smokes! Note that Henry received a free E3 pass, read our last update to find out how: http://steamcommunity.com/games/556740/announcements/detail/1318840070708036688

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/da3d36000dcc69e06f1526b64a000d5e7bf7bc48.png[/img][i]This is the face of excitement[/i]

As it turns out, 3 days simply wasn’t enough to take everything in. Lines were long everywhere! Henry waited in line for over an hour at Square Enix’s booth to play Dissidia Final Fantasy NT (and then got rekt in just 2 minutes *ooh*). Just when he thought the first day was bad, the second and third were even worse as lines grew even longer! In Henry’s own words, “it was worse than Disneyland.”   

Personally, Henry felt that most of the new games announced were rather underwhelming, except for Anthem (exclusively on XBox) and Spider-Man (PS4). Dissidia certainly was interesting and Tekken 7 was also fun to watch, but the outdoor esports arena was blazing hot and he couldn't stay for long. Microsoft's Xbox One Box X is a tongue-twister but seemed to lack those WOW factors that would justify the price tag. 

Having said that, overall Henry had a lot of fun in his first E3 and we'd like to share some snapshots from E3 2017 with you:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/b9c07b095e4ce48f04cf9b0313cc3a7009cb4e58.jpg[/img][i]Waited over an hour to play this[/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/d24aee2f4ed86886eca3d3ef7154f1dbda961b1c.jpg[/img][i]HUGE stage for Marvel vs. Capcom: Infinite[/i]
 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/78d4cd2f6f4dd7217a5b501bb041fd52c64221b8.jpg[/img][i]Playstation's Spider-Man[/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/38a2f846fbd507191e758870410e0b8d9c38190c.jpg[/img][i]Senran Kagura: Peach, Beach, Splash, need we say more? :D[/i]
 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/176af4fd7babed9b6bb6178292ad75808f5f108e.jpg[/img][i]Wanted to see Mobile Legends here[/i]

E3 wasn't just for the big boys though, there was also a special Indiecade corner for indie games who were lucky enough to score a much coveted space on the E3 floor, such as A Case of Distrust, Detention, Chkn, and One Way Trip. However, the space was rather small and we hope the area will be expanded so that more indie games can participate in the next few years.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/7e12590d61f66aa8071817bd02d37f3c2dbe10a9.png[/img][i]Some of the games from Indiecade[/i]

All in all, Henry had a lot of fun at his first E3, but the lines were simply too long - we hope this will be improved next year. The division of the halls and areas was also confusing. On the upside, the food trucks parked outside offered a unique Californian experience and Henry had fun trying out some outlandish lunch creations, such as a Japanese-inspired chicken katsu curry burger and a fusion chicken shawarma burrito - only in Los Angeles, right? :)

[h1]E3 Week MIX 2017[/h1] 

The FIRST highlight was showcasing Legrand Legacy in Media Indie Exchange (MIX), where we met with fellow devs and new media friends. Most people were excited to hear Legend of Dragoon and Suikoden as sources of inspiration and the comment we most often heard was "I know someone who will like this game."

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/5044c90bd8c617e873e430f98e9bffce2b0b6673.png[/img][i]Ready to rumble at E3 Week MIX 2017[/i]

The SECOND highlight was meeting one of our Kickstarter backers, Hugh, who has so kindly volunteered to represent Legrand Legacy in this event. Thank you Hugh! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/96e49cf9057cc0570ba127c378dcb7a6c44d6f63.png[/img][i]A selfie with our backer-volunteer, Hugh![/i]

The THIRD highlight was making it to Dual Shockers’ list of Best Indie Games From E3 2017! Thank you Azario Lopez & Dual Shockers, we are honored to be listed alongside our friends from Sundered, A Hat in Time, Children of Zodiarcs, and other wonderful gems that were shown at the MIX! Read more here: http://www.dualshockers.com/best-indie-games-e3-2017/  

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/70625dfc74a64047d628068ce16927cb2cb31580.png[/img][i]Thank you Dual Shockers![/i]

[h1]Thanks for Reading[/h1]  
We hope you had fun touring around E3 and MIX 2017 with us. Don't forget to check out our Twitter - https://twitter.com/LegrandLegacy - for additional short videos from E3 2017, including Tekken 7, Quake, WRC 7, and many more. Hope you're having a fun summer and we'll see you again next week!

-Revinia & the SEMISOFT team-

notes.title: We're Going to E3 & How to Get a Free E3 Pass
notes.content:
[h1]E3, Here We Come![/h1] 

A few weeks ago we extended a volunteering invitation for our Kickstarter backers and thanks to your warm response, we can finally showcase Legrand Legacy in E3 WEEK MIX 2017! As you're reading this, Henry has just arrived in Los Angeles after an almost 24-hour long flight. He's a little jetlagged but very much looking forward to meeting our backer-volunteer.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/a096bf64d9aaaefa0e558b681e6c2bc3bb5186aa.png[/img][i]Legrand Legacy in E3 Week MIX 2017![/i]

We are very proud to have been selected to participate in this curated event alongside our friends from Sundered and Monster Prom, as well as other awesome games! This event is also a HUGE deal for us because it will hopefully give us plenty of exposure during one of the biggest and most important gaming events in the entire world. So friends, please wish us the best of luck!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/bdb4f571c6190822c288ba3fd8ffef5c611a8396.png[/img][i]More than 50 fine indie games will be participating in E3 Week MIX 2017[/i]

If you're a member of the press, someone looking for fresh let's play materials and streaming contents, or interested in partnering with us in any capacity (we're looking for a publisher), please email us at hello@semisoft.co so we can set up a meeting in either E3 or the MIX.

[h1]How to Get a Free E3 Pass[/h1]

E3 has traditionally been industry-centric, however, this year they've decided to open their doors to the general public. Tickets don't come cheap but if you're working in the gaming industry, you can actually get a complimentary 3-day show floor pass complete with 5 meeting requests. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/930ef14a697a5a317f22ce583dde469b7ef81aff.jpg[/img][i]See you in E3[/i]

Note that registration was closed less than 2 months prior to the event, so don't forget to apply early next year.  

Despite being open for public, E3 remains pretty much a stomping ground for the big boys of the gaming industry. Booth prices are, sadly, not indiedev-friendly, but we hope E3 will continue to evolve to allow more indie developers to showcase our games in the next few years! 

[h1]Thanks for Reading[/h1] 

We hope you'll be able to take advantage of the tips above. If you can't come to E3 or MIX, but are curious to see more from Legrand Legacy, please email us at hello@semisoft.co. 

-Revinia & the SEMISOFT team-

notes.title: Last Day for Crowdfunding, Language Poll, Beta Announcement, and We’re Back from BitSummit Kyoto
notes.content:
[h1]Last Day for Crowdfunding[/h1]

Thanks everyone for making our Kickstarter and PayPal crowdfunding campaigns a smashing success! However, as we near our launch date, we have to close our PayPal page soon so we can get an accurate final tally for all rewards.

[h1]The last day for our crowdfunding campaign is MAY 31 (11:59 pm PDT).[/h1]

If you want to snap up the game at a lower price than MSRP, get your name immortalized in the credits section of the game, as well as other limited edition collectibles and exclusive in-game starter kits, please click here to contribute: https://paypal.legrandlegacy.com/

[url=https://paypal.legrandlegacy.com/projects/legrand-legacy-tale-of-the-fatebounds/][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/77e0166c3302b58d8c16493293215a02b8f90514.png[/img][/url][i]Don't forget to share this news with your friends[/i]

You can also help by [url=https://twitter.com/LegrandLegacy/status/867107886547189761]retweeting our Tweet[/url] OR by [url=https://www.facebook.com/legrandlegacy/photos/a.1742976472601938.1073741828.1742938055939113/1953442578221992/?type=3&theater]sharing our Facebook post[/url]. 

Thanks for your help! Every bit of money, retweet, and share, will help us make Legrand Legacy an even better game and experience for everyone. We hope we can reach the final few stretch goals before we close our crowdfunding campaign forever.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/5bc520cb5690f8644374465c5206a3b0c854161c.png[/img][i]We are so close to the next stretch goal![/i]

[h1]Language Poll[/h1]

Another big decision we have to make is which languages we should localize Legrand Legacy to. We’ve narrowed down our options to the three most requested languages: Spanish, French, and Japanese. However, if you want to play Legrand Legacy in another language that you think we should consider, please choose Others and leave your comment.

[url=https://twitter.com/LegrandLegacy][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/ad6d829182059b6b671c72e242febe22fecd7494.png[/img][/url][i]Click here to vote on Twitter[/i]

[url=https://www.facebook.com/legrandlegacy/][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/19d0fed6437babd8b2c9fa94cd98179f4b70e759.png[/img][/url][i]Click here to vote on Facebook[/i]

[h1]Beta Announcement[/h1]
  
As promised, we have been working very hard on Legrand Legacy's Beta. The good news is that we will be sending Beta keys to Kickstarter and PayPal backers in the Explorer (£40) tier and above on JUNE 1! The entire team has been pretty much operating on zombie mode for the past few weeks, but we all hope that you will enjoy playing Legrand Legacy's Beta.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/5823b19377d9a14e3481a9ab139a9dc3ab8214aa.png[/img][i]See you in Beta on June 1![/i]

[h1]Hope to See You Again BitSummit![/h1]
  
After two long weeks away from home, Uwil has finally landed back home! In short, BitSummit was EPIC. It was definitely THE BEST event we have ever been to and as icing on the cake, we met a few of our very own Kickstarter backers there! Hope everyone appreciates the new t-shirt packaging, which was rolled and labeled personally by... yours truly. Oh, just in case you're wondering, that egg-like character is Mayumaro, a silkworm cocoon who happens to be Kyoto's official mascot.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/cfffc965d7e2b53a1f90117d75deec28b6301539.png[/img][i]A collage of BitSummit goodness[/i]

Uwil had one day to explore Kyoto, so he decided to try some local delicacies, from home-made tofu, katsu rice, to green tea cookies and desserts. Uwil spent the rest of the day exploring the famous orange Fushimi Inari Shrine and the bustling Nishiki Market, as well as drooling over an authentic Persona5 art book and the widest selection of Gunplas he has ever seen!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/bf4584aa4d5a9b6d75c66104141b43da9b27d3ae.png[/img][i]Snapshots from Uwil's one day trip around Kyoto[/i]

You may recognize Luke and Anya’s names from your biweekly Kickstarter Games newsletter, but what you may not know is that they are the most hilarious and hardworking duo in the entire crowdfunding world. Our biggest thanks go out to Luke and Anya for being the most gracious and entertaining hosts. Thanks for offering Uwil a place to stay (because I booked an Airbnb at the wrong location), thanks for taking him out to dinner, and most of all, thanks for offering us the opportunity to showcase Legrand Legacy in one of the best indie game events in the entire world!  

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/04f9d1e58bd44ad8101d214ccc3f7a736c6733ff.png[/img][i]Uwil, Luke & Anya from Kickstarter Games, and team Sumer[/i]

We hope we’ll get the chance to showcase our game in BitSummit again next year. In the meantime, Uwil is going to practice his Japanese…  

じゃあまたね京都 (See you again Kyoto)  

[h1]Thanks for Reading[/h1]
  
That’s all for this week’s update. We'll report back next week with more updates from Legrand Legacy’s BETA!  

-Revinia & the SEMISOFT team-

notes.title: Casual Connect Singapore, BitSummit Kyoto, and Surveys for Kickstarter & PayPal Backers
notes.content:
[h1]Hello From Singapore, Lah![/h1]  
It was another insane week for the entire SEMISOFT crew as we continue pulling endless all-nighters to complete the next chapter of Legrand Legacy for our Beta. While things are going full swing back at the studio, Henry and AJ hit the road again to showcase Legrand Legacy, along with other finalists of Indie Prize, in Casual Connect Singapore.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/acce85de407941880856f9b86370b02d385836cc.png[/img][i]We are an Indie Prize Finalist![/i]

We brought a few BaoBao plushies with us and these lucky folks got to bring one home! Do you like these cuddly BaoBao plushies?

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/8a7c99a96d0647561bf3ced403efd0cb5c6361e5.png[/img][i]Thanks for giving BaoBao a new home[/i]

One of the highlights was live streaming Legrand Legacy with the hilarious guys of [url=https://twitter.com/quitstallingus]@QuitStalling[/url]. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/799ba114a062c0f633031735de215a426d6b25bf.jpg[/img][i]Thanks for having us guys[/i]

We'd like to thank Yuliya and everyone at Indie Prize for hosting us and a bunch of other game developers at this event. We're always thankful for any opportunity to showcase Legrand Legacy while meeting new friends from all over the world.

[h1]Konnichiwa Kyoto![/h1]

As we speak, Henry has arrived in Kyoto and is setting up Legrand Legacy’s booth in BitSummit. He’s super happy about the big monitor (this is truly the biggest screen we’ve ever gotten). We’re also sharing the show floor space with three other awesome Kickstarter games: Sumer, La-Mulana 2, and Project Scissors: NightCry.  

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/35d0833cdedd5e38024f72a97a3ad24507d1df11.jpg[/img][i]Such excites![/i]

We’re always impressed by how neat and organized everything is in Japan. It’s the day before BitSummit officially opens and there was no stray cable or unrolled carpet in sight.  

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/7c83ccc257e3961a58a8c484c2610c882562c797.jpg[/img][i]Biggest screen we've ever gotten[/i]

Alas, Henry’s first day in Kyoto proved to be rather eventful as I have accidentally booked him an Airbnb at the wrong location. Apparently Miyakomesse (where BitSummit is held) and Kyoto Conference Center are not the same thing. In fact, they’re located in opposite sides of town, 40 minutes apart! If you ever need to visit BitSummit, please don't make the same mistake I did - sorry Henry.

[h1]Surveys for Kickstarter & PayPal Backers[/h1]  
Events aside, this week we’ll start sending out surveys to all our Kickstarter and PayPal backers, so we can get your most updated information, including shipping address, t-shirt sizes, the names you want to include in the credits, and other important things or requests. So don’t forget to check your email and fill out those surveys to make sure that you will get the correct rewards on time!  

[h1]Thanks for Reading![/h1]
We can’t thank you enough for joining us on our journey and we hope that you enjoy reading our (mis)adventures through these updates.  

-Revinia & The SEMISOFT Team-

We’re also sharing the show floor space with three other awesome Kickstarter games: Sumer, La-Mulana 2, and Project Scissors: NightCry.

We’re always impressed by how neat and organized everything is in Japan. It’s the day before BitSummit officially opens and there was no stray cable or unrolled carpet in sight.

notes.title: Console Poll Results, Tactical War, and Preparing for Japan
notes.content:
[h1]Drum Roll Please...[/h1]

Switch won!

Thanks to Reddit, our poll caught the internet's attention and we received a grand total of 3,495 votes in Twitter and Facebook. At first we thought PS4/PSVita would surely win, but by the end of the poll, about 1,600 Nintendo fans had shown their interest in Legrand Legacy for Switch.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/dc23c5ff8a0c1b1ce8a71a74a6f41b705f44f9bf.png[/img]
[i]Twitter & Facebook poll results[/i]

Now that the poll is over (and with such an overwhelming response for Switch), we have some important decisions to make. We are not a big studio and we have limited resources and budget, so our final decision will be based mainly on economic viability. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/8d695e7732cd1bbca48ce4c8788a76f002a08188.png[/img]
[i]The news we posted on Facebook and Twitter[/i]

Rest assured whatever console we decide to port to, our Kickstarter and PayPal backers will be the first to know. However, you can still join us on our journey by subscribing to our weekly updates via [url=https://legrandlegacy.com/]legrandlegacy.com[/url].

[h1]Tactical War[/h1]

In the meantime, we've been pulling all-nighters in preparation for our Beta launch. One of the biggest features that will be making its debut appearance in our Beta is tactical war. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/016/645/230/31b09ad4688c8542fe9e4edc9bb1321d_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1494596665&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=53056c2692ad1678b3216519857d8f4b[/img]
[i]A GIF literally speaks a thousand words...[/i]

We haven't really talked about tactical war in details, but it was largely inspired by one of our favorite mechanics in Suikoden. We had so much fun creating strategies and putting our war general skills to the test while playing Suikoden that we can't help but to include a similar feature in our own game. 

Between the great war Mugna Feud and the tactical war feature, you may have realized that Legrand Legacy addresses the topic of war in a few aspects of the game. This is not unintentional and you will learn more as the story unfolds. We also consider this feature to be another story-telling mechanic through which you can experience our 6 heroes' progression.

Unfortunately we don't have a confirmed date for our Beta release yet, but stay tuned!

[h1]Konnichiwa Kyoto![/h1]

In preparation for our Japan trip, we decided to print a stack of Japanese brochures. This seemed like a good idea at first, but created quite a bit of chaos in the studio when we realized none of us speaks Japanese well (despite the fact that we're all JRPG fans). Thankfully, one of our team members, Aki, decided to roll up his sleeves and helped us with the translation. Hope we made our Japanese backers proud.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/20a56b66f145a06ea629161fa3f6e246390b79b3.png[/img]
[i]BitSummit here we come![/i]

Uwil is very nervous about having to speak in his limited Japanese, but he is definitely looking forward to playing other Kickstarter games that will be showcased in BitSummit. This will be his first time in Kyoto too so if you have any recommendations on places to visit, please let us know!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/1d694720200ecee45f55766e317901925bb8fd56.jpg[/img]
[i]The beautiful and majestic Kiyomizu Temple (photo courtesy of [url=http://www.planetware.com/tourist-attractions-/kyoto-jpn-ks-kyo.htm]planetware.com[/url])[/i]

[h1]Thanks for Reading![/h1]

It's been a hectic week but we're happy to share all the work that goes behind the scene. We also hope you enjoyed reading this update. We'll report back next week from the Indie Prize floor in Casual Connect Singapore and the Kickstarter Games area in BitSummit Kyoto!

-Revinia & The SEMISOFT Team-

notes.title: Nugaria - Smart, Young, and Deadly
notes.content:
As part of our Social Media Bonus Goal reward, we promised to include a new recruitable War General. Today we thought we'd let you have a sneak peek to Nugaria, a smart, young, and opinionated War General who was created with our Kickstarter backers in mind.  

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/016/287/936/b8508e6336f1d3ad1400ed0ea43a9197_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1492446222&auto=format&lossless=true&s=a81fe73345bb81e36f6dca06e4dacf3c[/img]

Nugaria is an adept general commanding a battalion hailing from the kingdom of Altea. Though still at a young age in comparison to the other generals, Nugaria has proven herself worthy of her rank. She joined the Altean army at a mere 16 years old and has since proven to her superiors that her combat prowess is to be respected by allies and feared by enemies.  

Although she can wield many different types of weapons, her weapon of choice is a dagger. Her lightning fast speed and powerful moves make Nugaria a deadly and fearsome combination. Nugaria also does not neglect her mind like many of her peers do. She studies in the ways of the war as much as she practices her dagger skills.

Fiercely loyal to the royal family of Altea, it is rumored that she in fact harbors feelings for one of the princes. Nugaria also too often wears her heart on her sleeves and isn't afraid to speak her mind, which often get her into hot water. Regardless of her shortcomings, she is a great valuable asset to the Altean army.  

[h1]Here’s the 3D model for Nugaria:[/h1]

[url=https://sketchfab.com/models/3d2ba8224e8f4adc9c9b140e22e2855c]Nugaria 3D Model[/url]

What do you think about this smart young War General?

notes.title: Alpha Has Landed (New Screenshots Included)
notes.content:
[h1]Calling All Adventurers and Beyond![/h1]  
If you have backed us at the Adventurer tier (£50) and above, you should have received an email with a detailed step-by-step on how to access Legrand Legacy’s Alpha demo. Please note that the Alpha is available via Steam only, but don't worry, you will still get the DRM-free copy when Legrand Legacy is officially released in September 2017.  

If you missed our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/984434986/legrand-legacy-tale-of-the-fatebounds/description]Kickstarter[/url] or don’t have a credit card, fret not, you can still support us via our [url=https://paypal.legrandlegacy.com/]PayPal[/url].

notes.title: Hello from Jakarta!
notes.content:
WE ARE HOME! After 3 weeks living out of suitcases and spending more time in airports than commonly acceptable, we are happy to announce that we have safely arrived home! However, there is no room for jet lag as things are in full swing back at the studio. The entire team is busy putting the final touches on our Alpha demo and it is currently on track to be released to our backers on March 31st.

[h1]SXSW Gaming[/h1] 

SXSW Gaming was considerably smaller than GDC or PAX, but what it lacked in size, it sure made up in character. We managed to squeeze in a little time to play Zelda on Nintendo Switch and other awesome indie games, including [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thunderlotus/sundered-a-horrifying-fight-for-survival-and-sanit]Sundered[/url] and [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thepedestrian/the-pedestrian]The Pedestrian[/url], but for the majority of our time, we were stationed at our booth to answer everyone's questions about the inspirations behind Legrand Legacy. Here are some of the pictures we took at SXSW Gaming - what do you think of those cute stickers?

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/016/000/296/72cb7072ef38dfe957dc74c4e8e7e02e_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1490453034&auto=format&lossless=true&s=7a68af7c00c564cb88cafb00bf3c9277[/img]

[h1]Check Out Battle Princess Madelyn![/h1]

Before we go, we want to share another wonderful project that we're currently backing, [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/causalbitgames/battle-princess-madelyn/]Battle Princess Madelyn[/url]. This game follows the journey of a young knight in training, Madelyn, and her ghostly pet dog Fritzy. They set out on a journey to save her kingdom and her family from the clutches of an evil wizard.

Sounds fun? We think so too!

At this time, Battle Princess Madelyn has crushed a long list of stretch goals and is well on her way to reach the PS Vita goal. The game looks amazing and the story behind it is so heart warming that we're sure you can't help but back this promising project. We hope that you'll give the Pre-Alpha a try and consider pledging for their limited edition PlayStation 4 physical copy!
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/999/613/60edc508d5276389868c0e2d142213b3_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1490447161&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=dbbb78a0b135106cd08fa1bb245a9e31[/img]

That's it for this week's update, see you next week!

notes.title: Oh, Stella & Hello from SXSW Gaming 2017!
notes.content:
The past week was probably the toughest for the entire team. Not only was our flight out of Boston canceled, we were also stuck in the midst of blizzard Stella and attacked by a flurry of vicious mini ice cubes without any proper winter gear. Oh, Stella...

[img]https://i.gjcdn.net/data/fireside/posts/3/149/237899/media/stella-xfxkzv9f.gif[/img]

However, after waiting in the airport for almost one whole day, the kind folks at Southwest Airlines managed to get us on another flight and these three musketeers finally landed in Austin just in time before SXSW Gaming began! It was our first time in Austin and we were immediately taken by how quirky and lively this city is. Musicians were performing in every corner and just strolling down the streets of Downtown Austin enveloped us with a sense of creative energy that is uniquely Austin.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/914/645/a31765fcaa40bffbf75ec6d61411254c_original.JPG?w=639&fit=max&v=1489861487&auto=format&q=92&s=53e62f1f253ce0194df4111c512ef139[/img]

As soon as our booth opened, we were swarmed by curious strangers who were first attracted by the beautiful art work printed on the t-shirts. We put a lot of heart into this art work and have prepared a few items bearing the same design especially for this trip. We're so glad that people appreciated the work that went into it.

As we have mentioned in an earlier update, Legrand Legacy was picked as a contestant in the SXSW Gaming Pitch Competition. Uwil & AJ spent days preparing for the presentation and we managed to get into the final 8! Competition was definitely fierce as all teams brought their A-game, but all in all, we learned how to further sharpen our pitch from the mentors and fellow finalists. Congratulations to [url=http://www.tesserastudios.com/]Tessera Studios[/url] and [url=http://www.swapbots.co/]Swap Bots[/url] for winning the Pitch Competition!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/914/614/f804a0bf50569b7fd53f2189f9b503b3_original.JPG?w=639&fit=max&v=1489861272&auto=format&q=92&s=6baca9147008fbe2047a55c3d457cf06[/img]

[h1]Post PAX East 2017 Thoughts[/h1]

There is no better way to describe it, PAX East was FUN and memorable. The energy was undeniably infectious and we met with a lot of RPG fans who were excited to see such a beautiful and classic yet modern looking game. We also met with a few Kickstarter backers, whom we hope are reading this update.

In this light-hearted video, we take you along on our journey across the USA, beginning with our scenic bus ride from NYC to Boston, all the way to the show floors at PAX East. Watch what other players think about Legrand Legacy and why Uwil refuses to have his shirt shown on camera.

https://youtu.be/mDIOFqosw6U
Thank you all for reading this update. Next week we will be reporting back from our studio as we prepare to release the Alpha demo for our backers. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Alpha Demo & Hello from PAX East 2017!
notes.content:
We packed our bags in San Francisco, took yet another long flight across USA, and unpacked our bags again in chilly Boston for PAX East. It was actually snowing this morning and it's probably fair to say that this tropical team is underdressed. However, while we are frozen cold, we are having a good time showcasing Legrand Legacy in PAX East and we also have a very important update to share with you -  Legrand Legacy’s Alpha demo!

[h1]Updates on Alpha Demo[/h1]  

Kickstarter backers who have pledged in the [b]Adventurer tier (£50)[/b]and above will be receiving Legrand Legacy’s Alpha demo on [b]March 31st[/b] The feedback we received was overwhelmingly in favor of version B’s battle system, so that’s what we will be using going forward. 

The Alpha demo will contain the first TWO chapters of Legrand Legacy so you will get a first look at how Finn and Aria’s adventures will unfold and an exclusive sneak peek to a whole new region to explore in Legrand, as well as updated visual effects and battle UI/UX, among others.  

If you have backed at a lower tier but now want a copy of our Alpha, please consider upgrading your pledge via [url=https://paypal.legrandlegacy.com/projects/legrand-legacy-tale-of-the-fatebounds/]Legrand Legacy’s PayPal[/url], where you can also check the current status of our project’s crowdfunding and how far we are from the next stretch goal (£47,000 with a new Mini Boss and its own unique bonus loot). If you are interested in upgrading your pledge, please email us at [h1]slackerbacker@semisoft.co[/h1].   

[h1]PAX East 2017[/h1]  

Today marks the first day of PAX East in Boston and it has been fun, busy, and crowded at the same time. The highlight of the day was meeting some of our Kickstarter backers and getting the chance to chat with them about how to improve several aspects of the mini games and tactical war. Here are some pictures from our booth in PAX East:  

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/819/010/e1fb85800d5ea4d0577554bb9f2e3a47_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1489179442&auto=format&q=92&s=52a034b8f40fd1f389f269fda3d8b38c[/img]

If you are attending PAX East in Boston, please come say hi to the team at booth 23120 from March 10-12. Just tell us you’re one of our Kickstarter backers and we have a special surprise for you!  

[h1]Post GDC Rants & Afterthoughts[/h1]  

In short, GDC was insanely hectic and memorable. We gathered even more feedback on how to improve players’ experience overall and also met a torrent of talented individuals from all aspects of the gaming industry, including publishers, musicians, artists, and of course, fellow game devs.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/813/740/bc80d436e06cf341ba48e98e894d17dc_original.JPG?w=639&fit=max&v=1489148037&auto=format&q=92&s=2b88c4ec07ecee0a36d8afc271133209[/img]

The highlight of our entire San Francisco trip was showcasing Legrand Legacy in the Game Jolt x Kickstarter party! It was such an honor to be showing alongside other awesome games like Moonlighter, The Adventure Pals, and Space Jammers. We also had a lot of fun playing these games and meeting Anya and Luke from Kickstarter Games!  

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/813/650/1a8f34fef939de2aa0df900ffd90c662_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1489147197&auto=format&q=92&s=fc9aafd298deb88c8a51bd0ffe2ceef3[/img]

Photos above courtesy of @AJ_theReal, @chibichibieris, @MassiveMonsters, and @_adaptiveplay.

Uwil and AJ's personal highlight, however, was meeting their idol, Daniel Floyd from Extra Credits.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/813/652/d74f201dd88b93e07ebdfe45ec1185e5_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1489147209&auto=format&q=92&s=eb155a76a5ee938032d63627cb0c7fce[/img]

In the following video, Uwil shares his thoughts on the aftermath of GDC 2017 - what we should've done better, what's up with Legrand Legacy's mini games, and why popcorn is your best friend!  

https://youtu.be/kPIQNA2b-P8

We also did a live interview with Beau Gaming who was kind enough to stop by our booth and has a bunch of cool videos from GDC 2017.  

[h1]2016 Giveaway Update[/h1] 

Towards the end of our first Kickstarter campaign in December 2016, we ran a few giveaways via Twitter and Facebook. Now that we are funded, we are able to continue with the development of Legrand Legacy and thus, honor the winners of these giveaways. If you have won, we will be contacting you soon with more information. 

That’s it for this week’s update! We hope that you have enjoyed the videos and pictures included here. We will be back next week with more live updates from SXSW Gaming Expo in Austin. If you want to follow the team's journey, you can follow our personal Twitter (@uwilwinata, @aj_thereal, @chibichibieris). 

See you next week!

notes.title: Inspired by the Wild
notes.content:
Legrand is chockfull of malicious monsters, gruesome beasts, and a dash of the familiar. The inspirations behind the following monsters are easily recognizable while still having the Legrand Legacy twist applied to them.

For today’s update, we wanted to talk about a couple of monsters that are inspired by the wild: Smutar and Mbedug! 

[h1]Smutar, the Paralyzing Ant[/h1]

Smutars are family creatures that live in big colonies with thousands of other members of its species. They are hard workers who burrow deep underground to establish their nest, but they migrate frequently according to the season. 

The glowing red sphere at their back acts as a lure that attracts smaller species which are paralyzed upon contact. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/408/205/ac47c9e1774d0c74aa0298211e85cca1_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1486361965&auto=format&lossless=true&s=406e9d3170d5d6f300e9cd3c5afaf69a[/img]

[url=https://sketchfab.com/models/c03db799f2a24abd9b7b82f7924a0e77]Here’s the 3D model for Smutar[/url]

[h1]Mbedug, the Witches’ Favorite[/h1]

Mbedugs are solitary mammals that can be easily recognized by their stout long horn and fluffy ears. Their horns are a precious and sought-after commodity as local witches often use them in their mysteriously vile brews. 

While Mbedugs do spend most of their time sleeping and eating, be careful if you happen to meet one in the wild - they can suddenly charge and attack without warning! 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/408/209/36c2217c34050eeabc4287da71668698_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1486362083&auto=format&lossless=true&s=f0d9659627f99f9afd258004bd2b4bae[/img]

[url=https://sketchfab.com/models/a8ec1c9ab1ca4f8faee096c1bcb60bc8]Here’s the 3D model for Mbedug[/url]

notes.title: Version A vs. Version B
notes.content:
By now you’ve probably played the new version B of our Pre-Alpha. You may be wondering, what’s the difference behind this new version and the previous one (version A)?

[b]VERSION A[/b] is the original Pre-Alpha that we launched with our first Kickstarter. If you watch YouTube Let’s Play videos dated before January 18th, 2017, they are most likely playing this build. Version A is available only on GameJolt.

[b]VERSION B[/b] is the revised Pre-Alpha that we launched with this new Kickstarter. We took your feedback from last time and have implemented some changes into this new build. Version B is available on Steam as well as on GameJolt.

Now let’s talk about some of the things that have changed in Version B.

[h1]Battle UI[/h1]

A big change for version B is that we now have an additional user interface which gives you detailed information about the enemy. This includes, for example, monster type, element type, weakness, and HP bar. Our goal is to make it easier for you to plan your attack and defense actions.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/279/452/e0d1683ca42bb8b67a45750f21a43e2d_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1485320742&auto=format&lossless=true&s=b093b9ac355290c4118c0a98e6a66813[/img]

[h1]Action Circle Tempo (ACT)[/h1]

You will notice that ACT now only appears at the beginning of combat. Also, based on popular request, you can now choose your own flavor for ACT depending on the desired playing experience:  

•	You can choose either to press a fixed button (easier) or to get randomized buttons (harder)

•	You can choose either to have a fixed (easier) or randomized (harder) Perfect/Good area

•	The arrows in version A have been replaced with ABXY, which we hope will make it more intuitive

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/279/488/70cd8b2dcd7181868e94c2e465e31ad0_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1485321045&auto=format&lossless=true&s=be869230df6d346155b93e41d50cf23e[/img]

[h1]Character’s Skill Attribute[/h1]

At the end of the battle, you can now immediately add Attribute Points (ATP) to level up your character.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/279/504/6632f447b9292b94310c54369a691978_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1485321178&auto=format&lossless=true&s=97892e3bc67cd65b345e8a675106485b[/img]

[h1]Other Cosmetic Changes[/h1]

You may also notice several cosmetic changes which we hope will make your experience more enjoyable. These include enhanced visual effects, improved textures for some monsters, map pointers, and more!

[h1]Why do we have two versions of the Pre-Alpha?[/h1]

We want Legrand Legacy to be a game that YOU enjoy, so we will be conducting a poll after the Kickstarter is over to gather your feedback about both versions so that we can know into which direction to take the Legrand Legacy gameplay.

[url=https://ksr-video.imgix.net/assets/015/279/540/bdc6c2ed73396eba15ed61b7a4aabad3_h264_high.mp4]check the video here![/url]

But for now, we do want to hear from you! Do you prefer the ACT dial to appear right before each attack and defense action (as is the case for version A) or all at once at the beginning of combat (as it happens now in version B)? Please let us know in the comments below!

notes.title: Live 2D: Bringing Characters to Life
notes.content:
Hi! We wanted to start today's update by mentioning that Legrand Legracy is now part of Kickstarter's Projects We Love! Be sure to share the image below on social media to show your support!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/639/716/acc3a6444d846cdce171870bb9863f55_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1479921380&auto=format&q=92&s=7e8afcc24e1a5a2169ca426fd044f838[/img]

An RPG like Legrand Legacy consists of many different components, from characterization, script writing, world and game design, not to mention its original soundtrack! Today we want to take you on a tour behind the scenes of the game’s production so that we can talk about a very important feature of Legrand Legacy: Live 2D.

If you have tried the Legrand Legacy Pre-alpha Prologue you’ll know that the game uses visual novel style conversations combined with Live 2D for its story and to convey the characters’ emotions. An animated expression truly creates a more dynamic experience compared to a static image!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/634/984/f788ff7f980228c038a03ad64a851ab9_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1479889069&auto=format&q=92&s=490345c637ac02ad7219bd2ed17ac2e4[/img]

Now, let's talk about the actual process to make this all happen. Generally speaking, there are four steps to bring the characters' emotions alive thanks to Live 2D.

Step 1: Prepare the Original Drawing: First, the artist will prepare an image of the character. It’s best to use an image with less shading in some areas like the eyes, eyebrows, nose, ears, and mouth, because too much shading will complicate the slicing process.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/634/936/ab1ddbcc30e229e52c1c5be8c3ebe15f_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1479888358&auto=format&q=92&s=30ab4ccca09ad19f4c4cc962f64eb282[/img]

2. Create a Model : Next, we continue to modelling by using the Live 2D Cubism Modeler. We set the parameters for a character’s facial features, all depending on the expression we want to present. In this case we could, for example, change the angle of her eyebrows or the shape of her mouth.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/634/942/363a97c03cb16e3c5cee971c0e8c89dd_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1479888423&auto=format&q=92&s=55b32202776d168551074fa95c44730c[/img]

3. Create the Animation: After the parameters are set, it’s time to animate a character’s facial expression by using Live 2D Cubism Animator. In this step, the artist has to control the parameters to get a smooth animation in the end.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/634/950/af490fa4254a73dd9644205bad41026a_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1479888557&auto=format&q=92&s=bb180c357537404c1f1706e0e904bb2f[/img]

4. In-Game Implementation: Once the Live 2D animation is ready, we need to add it into the game at the correct spot, all according to our script.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/634/987/f55a2a0597ac0afe1b925a2bee12424f_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1479889099&q=92&s=4470ad155874156c0733ed22fb5c9e57[/img]

The process of making Live 2D requires focus and precision but, above all, the artists need to have a deep understanding of the characters’ emotions and personalities, so that they can truly bring the characters to life.

We hope you liked today's Kickstarter update. Let us know what you think about it in the comments below!
